backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing person records with validation for fields, numeric ranges, and blob image storage.
feature_evidence.json: Report linking implemented features to files, components, and test IDs for height-unit UI updates and validation changes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of frontend components, validators, pages, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based styles defining OKLCH color variables and light/dark theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component wrapping the records page in the main layout and toaster.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout component providing header, main content area, and branded footer with theme-aware styling.
frontend/src/features/records/emptyState: Provides UI components for empty record lists and when no record is selected.
Defines create, update, and delete record mutations using the actor API with query invalidation and toasts.
frontend/src/features/records/queries.ts: Exposes hooks to list and read records via the actor, using react-query for caching.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordDeta: Record detail view showing personal data, image, and edit/delete actions with icon-based sections.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordForm: Form component for creating or editing records with validation, image upload, and submit handling.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordImag: Image upload field supporting preview, clearing, and handling existing ExternalBlob images.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordsLis: Displays a list of records with loading and empty states, allowing selection and showing avatars and basic info.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordsPag: Main records management page coordinating list, detail, create/edit dialogs, and delete confirmation.
frontend/src/features/records/types.ts: Contains form data types and utilities to convert between form data and backend Data objects.
frontend/src/features/records/validators: Validates record form fields including name, mobile number, dates, numeric ranges, and image size.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Initializes and manages the backend actor based on identity and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context, providing identity management, login, logout, and status handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and a full set of OKLCH CSS variables for light and dark themes, plus base element styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, sets up React Query and the InternetIdentityProvider, and mounts the App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color tokens, typography, container queries, animations, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata including requirements, existing features, architectural notes, and pending feature requests.
